name: uber-1.0.0
description: Request and manage Uber rides — fare estimates, ride requests, status tracking, cancellation

tools.name: uber
tools.description: Universal Uber ride tool. Actions: 'products' (list available), 'estimate' (get fare/time quote), 'request' (book a ride), 'status' (track current ride), 'cancel' (cancel ride), 'history' (recent rides), 'auth_url' (get OAuth setup URL). Uses sandbox by default for safety.

action.description: What to do: products, estimate, request, status, cancel, history, auth_url

env.name: UBER_SERVER_TOKEN
env.description: Server token for price/product queries (no OAuth needed)

env.name: UBER_ACCESS_TOKEN
env.description: OAuth2 access token for ride requests (run auth_url flow first)

env.name: UBER_USE_PRODUCTION
env.description: Set to 'true' for real rides (default: false = sandbox)
